test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

One who believes in fate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Fatalist"** means a person who believes that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable. (भाग्यवादी)

 
 
• **Example:** As a fatalist, he believed that no matter what he did, the outcome of his life was already decided.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
